title: Double Each
goal: Walk the slice and push each element doubled.
hints: The loop yields one element at a time, not a pair.
Doubling is multiplication. The tests notice the difference.
explanation: Iterating a slice yields one element per pass, so the pattern is a single name - a tuple pattern expects pairs (E0308), and type annotations do not belong in for patterns. Then the arithmetic: `n + 2` compiles as happily as `n * 2`, and only the tests can tell doubling from adding two. Compiling green is not passing green.
